title: Sources detail Intel's turnaround under Lip-Bu Tan as AI demand for CPUs boosts business; Intel's deal to make Arm's AI data center chip fell through in 2024 (Michael Acton/Financial Times)
summary: Michael Acton / Financial Times: Sources detail Intel's turnaround under Lip-Bu Tan as AI demand for CPUs boosts business; Intel's deal to make Arm's AI data center chip fell through in 2024 — The group's shares have quadrupled, but it has yet to prove itself a serious manufacturing competitor to Taiwan's TSMC.
